chapters.title: Topic, identity and の
chapters.summary: The は topic marker, the copula pattern, and の joining nouns - the frame every other sentence hangs off.

chapters.title: Existence and place
chapters.summary: あります/います, plus the に and で particles that say where something is or happens.

chapters.title: Objects and going places
chapters.summary: を marks what the verb acts on; に with 行く/来る/帰る/戻る marks where you are headed.

chapters.title: Asking questions
chapters.summary: The core question words: who, what, where, when, which, how many.

chapters.title: Asking how and why
chapters.summary: How you do something, why, and how something is said.

chapters.title: Someone, anyone, everyone
chapters.summary: Question word + か for 'some-', + でも for 'any-'. One rule, applied across every question word you just learned.

chapters.title: Nobody, nothing, nowhere
chapters.summary: Question word + も with a negative verb. The upstream data lists this pattern ten times over (polite and plain, three particles); it is one rule, not ten.

chapters.title: Adjectives
chapters.summary: い- and な-adjectives: negative, adverbial, and the て/で forms that let them join.

chapters.title: Making and becoming
chapters.summary: する for a change you cause, なる for one that happens.

chapters.title: The て-form
chapters.summary: The most load-bearing verb form in the language: joining clauses, ongoing action, requests. 74 later points presuppose it.

chapters.title: Before, after, when
chapters.summary: Ordering events in time, and the とき clause.

chapters.title: Times and approximations
chapters.summary: から〜まで ranges, and ごろ/くらい/ぐらい for 'about'.

chapters.title: Wanting and being able
chapters.summary: たい, ほしい, できる, and the こと/の nominalisers that let a whole verb phrase act as a noun.

chapters.title: Comparing
chapters.summary: より, のほうが, いちばん, and asking which of two.

chapters.title: Listing and limiting
chapters.summary: と, や〜など, か〜か, も, だけ, and たり〜たり.

chapters.title: Giving a reason
chapters.summary: から and だから for cause. What separates them is register, not meaning.

chapters.title: But: one meaning, many registers
chapters.summary: が, けど, けれど, でも, しかし, けれども all mean 'but'. The lesson is the register ladder, not six separate patterns - which is why the formal siblings from higher levels are taught here too.

chapters.title: Joining sentences
chapters.summary: そして, それから and the 'well then' connectives.

chapters.title: Suggesting and inviting
chapters.summary: ましょう, ませんか and the polite ways to offer.

chapters.title: Giving and receiving
chapters.summary: あげる, もらう, くれる - who gives what to whom, and why Japanese cares.

chapters.title: How often, how much
chapters.summary: Frequency and degree adverbs, including the あまり/ぜんぜん negatives.

chapters.title: Already, still, soon
chapters.summary: もう, まだ, もうすぐ, すぐに, さっき.

chapters.title: Polite pointers
chapters.summary: こちら/そちら and a few set expressions.

chapters.title: Plain form and experience
chapters.summary: た ことがある and its siblings - what the plain past unlocks.

chapters.title: Potential, passive, causative
chapters.summary: られる, させる, させられる - the three derived voices.

chapters.title: て-form auxiliaries
chapters.summary: ている, てある, ておく, てしまう, てみる, ていく, てくる - the て-form's second life as an auxiliary slot.

chapters.title: Giving and receiving, revisited
chapters.summary: The giving verbs again, now with their humble and honorific forms.

chapters.title: Doing things for people
chapters.summary: てあげる, てくれる, てもらう - the benefactive の direction of an action.

chapters.title: Asking politely
chapters.summary: The request ladder, from てくれませんか up to ていただけませんか. Pure register - the meaning never changes.

chapters.title: Must and may
chapters.summary: Obligation five ways - and the five differ only by register. Plus permission and prohibition.

chapters.title: Advice
chapters.summary: たほうがいい, ないほうがいい, たらいい, ばいい, といい, なさい.

chapters.title: Intention and purpose
chapters.summary: つもり, ようと思う, ために, ように, and the ようにする/ようになる pair.

chapters.title: Guessing and hearsay
chapters.summary: かもしれない, だろう, でしょう, ようだ, みたいだ, そうだ - how certain you are, and where you heard it.

chapters.title: Quoting and embedding
chapters.summary: と思う, という, っていう, かどうか - putting a whole clause inside a sentence.

chapters.title: Explaining
chapters.summary: のです/んです, ので, のに, and し for stacked reasons.

chapters.title: While, during, by then
chapters.summary: ときに, 間に, までに, 中, ところ, ながら.

chapters.title: Verb compounds
chapters.summary: 出す, 終わる, 続ける, にくい, やすい, すぎる, 方.

chapters.title: Degrees and limits
chapters.summary: ほど, より, しか〜ない, ばかり, まで, ずつ.

chapters.title: Changing and deciding
chapters.summary: くする/なる, にする/なる, ことにする/ことになる - deliberate change against change that happens to you.

chapters.title: Even if, as it is
chapters.summary: ても/でも, まま, and the remaining connectives.
